stages.name: dataset discovery
stages.outcome: Publisher SIOTUGA, INE-keyed WMS+WFS, and the plan PDF all found. Faster than any of the five shipped cities.

stages.name: legal stack
stages.outcome: PXOM identified; 5 sibling vintages disambiguated; WFS discovered; ordenación proven RASTER; in-force vector layer proven EMPTY.

stages.name: variable resolution
stages.outcome: Censused all 8 vector layers. NO depth/height/setback/coverage field exists in any schema. FAR (edif_ficha) 1.8% populated, and only on the SUPERSEDED-VINTAGE sector fichas. LONGEST STAGE.

stages.name: constraint resolution
stages.outcome: Real parcel + soil class resolved with ZERO new code. Governing article located verbatim in primary bytes. Second refusal ground (PEPRI) established.

stages.name: determination
stages.outcome: Refusal stated. Near-zero because stage 4 had already assembled the whole citation chain.

determination.denominator: The 0% ENVELOPE figure is a CENSUS of the publisher's own service, not a sample: the in-force vector cualificación layer returns 0 features UNFILTERED across the whole municipality. The 100% REFUSAL figure is asserted for the one parcel carried end-to-end (N=1) and is NOT a city-wide measurement — see notMeasured.
determination.refusalCategoryNote: NOT legally terminal. Lei 2/2016 Art. 53 GRANTS an envelope in solo urbano consolidado; it is the DATA that refuses, not the law. Two independent delegations, either sufficient alone: (a) the cualificación is published only as raster; (b) the parcel is inside the Recinto Amurallado, delegated to a PEPRI that SIOTUGA does not serve and whose host returns 502.

tier.label: Tier 2 — determination only: correct refusal with cited article
tier.why: Tier 1 is impossible: no vector planning data carrying envelope variables is published for the in-force plan. Tier 3 is wrong: the refusal IS produced, correctly, with a verbatim statutory citation and a real parcel behind it.
tier.tier1CeilingCaveatNote: Not claiming Tier 1, so the unmodelled-constraint caveat does not gate this result. Recorded anyway for the programme: airport, flood and infrastructure constraints remain UNMODELLED across the whole programme and constrain downward, so every published envelope anywhere is an upper bound with a missing ceiling. Lugo would add a fifth: UNESCO World Heritage buffer around the Roman wall.

hypotheticalAdapterIfDataExisted.detail: One INE-keyed URL template — https://siotuga.xunta.gal/siotuga/ws?codine=<INE> — serves all 313 Galician concellos over both WMS and WFS. This is the single most reusable publisher pattern the programme has met. It buys CLASIFICACIÓN only.
hypotheticalAdapterIfDataExisted.measuredCaveat: For Lugo's in-force plan that adapter returns 0 features. The generic surface is excellent and the payload is empty.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: WHICH of 5 sibling instrument vintages governs. The service exposes P.X.O.U._199012, PXOM_201104, MP_201604, MP_201903 and PXOM_202304 side by side with NO in-force flag, no validity dates, no supersession links.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: Decoding the undocumented layer-name grammar, then reading a Galician-language gazette announcement.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: Whether the 2023 expediente SUPERSEDES or COMPLETES the 2011 one. I initially concluded 'supersedes'. WRONG.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: BOP Lugo N.º 258 of 10-11-2023 states the 2023 act approves only 'os ámbitos e determinacións que non foron obxeto de aprobación pola Orde da CMATI do 29-04-11'. BOTH are in force over different ámbitos.
humanJudgementPoints.classification: SUPERSEDED belief — recorded per BLOCKER-CLASSIFICATION-STANDARD, the category that generates institutional learning

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: That CLASIFICACIÓN (3CLAS) is NOT CUALIFICACIÓN and cannot substitute for it. Two near-identical Spanish words; only one carries the envelope.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: Lei 2/2016 Art. 53.b) read verbatim. A field-name-matching adapter would have shipped soil classes as if they were zoning.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: Whether edif_ficha (1.8% populated, values 0.150-1.250) may be published as a FAR.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: NO. It is a sector-ficha figure on the 2011 vintage, with no height/coverage/setback companion. ADR-0284: derived law is not permissible. A FAR without a height ceiling over-states, exactly as L-616.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: Whether the parcel falls inside the Recinto Amurallado, which changes the governing instrument entirely.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: Visual inspection of the rendered raster sheet against the parcel coordinate. There is no vector heritage boundary to test against.
humanJudgementPoints.note: THIS ONE IS DAMNING: the trigger for a whole separate legal regime is only visible to a human looking at a picture.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: Whether to trust a summarising fetch's article citation.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: NO. WebFetch returned a fabricated 'Artigo 45. Determinacións de ordenación detallada'; the primary bytes show Artigo 45 is 'Instrumentos de planeamento urbanístico'. Caught only because the primary source was held locally.
humanJudgementPoints.note: Automatable as a RULE (never cite an article not verified against local bytes), not as a judgement.

humanJudgementPoints.judgement: How to treat the publisher's own declaration that its vector data has NO LEGAL VALIDITY.
humanJudgementPoints.resolvedBy: Escalated, not resolved. This is a Legal blocker under BLOCKER-CLASSIFICATION-STANDARD and freezes any engineering that would publish an entitlement from SIOTUGA vectors.

breaks.title: The publisher DISCLAIMS LEGAL VALIDITY of its own vector planning data
breaks.verbatim: La información vectorial no tiene validez legal al tratarse de un producto derivado de los planos del documento original diligenciado, pero no formar parte del mismo.
breaks.detail: Also warns of unresolved geopositioning errors. Engages ADR-0284 and ADR-0288 head-on.

breaks.title: Supersession unresolved in the service

breaks.detail: PORD_02CL in WMS only; WFS exposes only its TILEINDEX (43 sheets, 0.0% attribute population). GetFeatureInfo returns one attribute-less gml:Box PER PIXEL. GetMap returns 1136623 B of plan imagery.
breaks.neverExposedBecause: Barcelona/Madrid/Murcia/Córdoba/València all had SOME vector zoning; Córdoba's raster problem was 41 dead sheets, not a live raster-only service

breaks.title: ADVERTISED + FULLY SCHEMA'D + EMPTY
breaks.detail: _27028_PXOM_202304_AD_3CLAS_28600: in GetCapabilities, DescribeFeatureType returns all 19 fields incl. edif_ficha, and GetFeature UNFILTERED returns 0 features (750 B); GetMap 1476 B blank; GetFeatureInfo 'no results'. Three independent methods agree; both bbox axis orders tested.

breaks.neverExposedBecause: prior cities' zoning layers carried the ordinance code directly; here the only vector layer is a decoy that a field-matching adapter would happily consume

breaks.title: The obvious search result is the WRONG legal document
breaks.detail: Web search for the Lugo normativa returns 27519no002.pdf (2011). The expediente number is the ONLY discriminator and is learnable only by decoding WMS layer names.

breaks.detail: 27519no002.pdf: 131048 text operators, 595796 chars, ALL mojibake. ToUnicode occurs 0 times (vs 2 in the 2023 doc, which extracted cleanly). Transcription needs OCR, not parsing.
breaks.neverExposedBecause: Madrid's Compendio and Murcia's vol. 11 both had clean text layers; 'born-digital' was treated as equivalent to 'extractable'

breaks.detail: Parcel is inside the Recinto Amurallado -> PEPRI (Decreto 443 do 22-02-1973) governs, not the PXOM ordinance. SIOTUGA serves 0 plan-especial layers for Lugo. Its host returns HTTP 502. The only way to know the trigger fired was to LOOK AT A PICTURE.
breaks.neverExposedBecause: prior cities' heritage overlays were at least enumerable (València's returned 499 Token Required — gated but VISIBLE). Here it is invisible.

Whether the 2011 3CLAS layer covers the URBAN core. The 3000-feature draw hit MAXFEATURES and skewed rural (SRPAU/SRPAG). Total feature count unknown — no returnCountOnly on this MapServer WFS 1.1.0.
PEPRI content. Both known hosts 502. Cannot say whether it is machine-readable, only that we could not reach it.

Whether ToUnicode maps hide inside compressed object streams of the 2011 PDF. Measured only that naive extraction yields mojibake.
Any raster->vector cost for PORD_02CL. Deliberately not estimated: Córdoba D-002 forbids assuming vectorisation is authorised.

verdict: TRUE ADAPTER COST FOR A COLD PUBLISHER: 27.4 minutes to a correct, article-cited determination, with ZERO lines of municipality-specific code. The cost is NOT engineering. Every one of the seven human-judgement points is a LEGAL or SEMANTIC reading, and the binding constraint is that the in-force plan's envelope data is a picture. Galicia's publisher surface is the BEST the programme has met (one INE-keyed template, 313 municipalities) and its payload for the plan that governs is EMPTY.
